description.zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。
设置结束时间，查询在**EndTime**前产生的操作日志。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒。
description.en: The end time. Operation logs that were generated before this time are queried.**** The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstanceList](~~118698~~)查询所有DDoS原生防护实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the instance to query.

> You can call the [DescribeInstanceList](~~118698~~) operation to query the IDs of all instances.

The type of the operation. Valid values:

*   **3**: Add an IP address to the instance.
*   **4**: Remove an IP address from the instance.
*   **5**: Downgrade the instance.
*   **6**: Deactivate blackhole filtering.
*   **7**: Reset the number of times that you can deactivate blackhole filtering.
*   **8**: Restore the mitigation capability.
*   **9**: Add an asset group.
*   **10**: Remove an asset group.
*   **11**: Enable the metering method of daily 95th percentile for the burstable clean bandwidth feature.
*   **12**: Enable the metering method of monthly 95th percentile for the burstable clean bandwidth feature.
*   **13**: Periodically switch between the metering methods of daily 95th percentile and monthly 95th percentile for the burstable clean bandwidth feature.
*   **14**: Disable the metering method of daily 95th percentile for the burstable clean bandwidth feature.
*   **15**: Disable the metering method of monthly 95th percentile for the burstable clean bandwidth feature.
*   **16**: Disable burstable clean bandwidth due to overdue payments.
*   **17**: Disable burstable clean bandwidth due to instance expiration.

description.zh: 设置操作日志的排序字段。取值固定为**opdate**，表示按照操作时间排序。
description.en: The sorting method of operation logs. Set the value to **opdate**, which indicates sorting based on the operation time.

description.zh:
设置操作日志的排序方式。取值：

- **ASC**：表示按照正序排序。
- **DESC**：表示按照倒序排序。

默认：**DESC**
description.en:
The sort order of operation logs. Valid values:

*   **ASC**: the ascending order.
*   **DESC**: the descending order.

Default value: **DESC**.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含操作日志的数量。最大值：50。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50.

description.zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~118703~~)查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the instance resides.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~118703~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

description.zh: 设置开始时间，查询在**StartTime**后产生的操作日志。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒。
description.en: The start time. Operation logs that were generated after this time are queried.**** The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于分页查询DDoS原生防护的操作日志。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call the DescribeOpEntities operation to query the operation logs of an instance by page.

### Limit

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddosbgp describe-op-entities --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --start-time 1609430400000 --end-time 1640880000000 --order-by opdate --order-dir ASC --instance-id ddosbgp-cn-n6w1r7nz0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --op-action 3 --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddosbgp DescribeOpEntities --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy opdate --PageSize 10 --EndTime 1640880000000 --OrderDir ASC --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm2pz25js0000' --CurrentPage 1 --InstanceId 'ddosbgp-cn-n6w1r7nz0000' --StartTime 1609430400000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --OpAction 3
